title: Audit native ModelClient tool-call seam and document runtime support level
description:
Resolve or explicitly document the mismatch between the future-ready ModelClient contract and the current fenced-text tool protocol runtime.

This bead should either implement support for native toolCalls if already practical, or make the current fenced-text-only behavior explicit in tests/docs so agents do not assume native tool calls work.

## Context
Observed gap:
- The model contract appears to carry native tool definitions / response hints / optional native toolCalls.
- Runtime behavior appears centered on parsing fenced text tool calls from model text.
- Adapter(s) may flatten messages and ignore native tool channels, response-format hints, profile, or trace metadata.
- This is a seam clarity issue that can cause future agents to build against a contract path that is not actually active.

Parallel-safety:
- Does not overlap SRD importer parser beads.
- Avoid running in parallel with major orchestrator/model refactors.
- Keep scope to support-level audit, tests, and small targeted implementation if straightforward.
design:
Suggested files to inspect:
- packages/core/src/model/client.ts
- packages/core/src/model/*
- packages/core/src/orchestrator/orchestrator.ts
- provider adapter files
- tests around model loop, tool protocol parsing, and adapter behavior
- docs describing model/tool protocol, if present

Implementation options:
A. Document/defer native tool calls:
   - Add explicit docs/comments saying fenced-text tool protocol is the only supported runtime path.
   - Add tests proving ignored native fields are intentionally ignored or unsupported.
   - Make unsupported native toolCalls fail loudly or be ignored with clear trace metadata.
B. Implement native toolCalls:
   - Teach runModelLoop to consume result.toolCalls.
   - Preserve fenced-text compatibility.
   - Add tests covering both native and fenced tool-call paths.
   - Update adapter capability docs.

Recommendation:
- Prefer option A unless native toolCalls can be implemented without destabilizing the orchestrator.
acceptance_criteria:
- Runtime support level is explicit: fenced-text-only for now, or native toolCalls supported.
- Tests cover the chosen behavior.
- Adapter behavior for native tool definitions/toolCalls/response hints is not accidental or undocumented.
- Public/internal docs do not imply native tool calls work unless they actually do.
- Existing fenced-text tool protocol continues to pass tests.
- No SRD importer parser files are modified.
close_reason: Audited the native ModelClient tool-call seam (PR #169). Runtime support level is now explicit and enforced: runModelLoop rejects native toolCalls/stopReason=tool_use with OrchestratorError (fenced-text protocol only). Contract docs updated; orchestrator tests + existing adapter test cover the behavior.
